response.enhanced_information: Hyoscine, also known as scopolamine, is the most effective drug for the prophylaxis of motion sickness due to its action of blocking muscarinic receptors, which prevents the symptoms associated with motion sickness. Other drugs such as Metoclopramide, Prochlorperazine, and Ondansetron are not primarily used for this purpose and are less effective in this context.
